subject: Clearline exec demo — CIO presence and handoff plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo for CIO / exec team?

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the call last week. Our CIO, Neel, wants to see the platform in action before we proceed to procurement. High level ask: 45-minute demo focused on production performance and security posture (latency, multi-tenant isolation, and audit logs). Ideally Neel + our VP of Engineering attend.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should be present for exec-level questions? Preferably someone who can speak to latency comparisons and one person who can cover security/compliance.

Possible windows: week of Nov 15 — mornings PST or late afternoons (we are flexible). If you have a preferred slot, send a calendar hold and we’ll confirm.

I attached our short RFP summary for reference.

Thanks —
Sanjay Rao
Director of Infrastructure
Clearline Health

Attachments: clearline_rfp.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@clearlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo for CIO / exec team?

Hi Sanjay —

Appreciate the context and the RFP. We can run a focused 45-minute session: 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. Suggested attendees from our side:
- Marissa Cole — customer sponsor; will lead exec framing and ROI discussion
- Jonas Weber (me) — runtime demo and performance examples
- Kimberly Park — security/compliance (SOC2, audit logs) if you want deeper posture discussion

Two windows that work for our execs: 
- Wed, Nov 17, 15:00–15:45 PST
- Thu, Nov 18, 10:00–10:45 PST

I’ve tentatively created a calendar hold for the first slot here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=proposed-hold-abc123 — please confirm which one works and we’ll send an invite with the final attendee list.

Also: would Neel prefer an \"executive overview\" (concise business + topline architecture) or a slightly more technical walkthrough with latency benchmarks and quantization/throughput examples? We can tailor the 30-min demo accordingly.

Next steps: confirm slot, let us know final attendees, and we’ll share a short pre-read + a 15-min prep call option for Neel if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: link to MAP and a quick one-pager (will attach final deck once slot confirmed)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Clearline exec demo — proposed runbook (internal planning)

Internal note (do not forward to Clearline):

Thanks for looping me in. Suggested runbook to keep the demo tight for the CIO:
- 00:00–02:00 (first 2 min) — quick intros and outcome statement (I’ll lead)
- 02:00–20:00 (18 min) — runtime demo: cold start, streaming response, KV cache hit, and latency numbers (Jonas lead)
- 20:00–30:00 (10 min) — deployment/ops + cost controls: Dedicated vs Hosted routing + Optimize suggestions (Grace to cover if available)
- 30:00–40:00 (10 min) — security/compliance: SOC2 artifacts, VPC/private deployment options, audit logs (Kimberly lead)
- 40:00–45:00 — Q&A / next steps (all)

Kimberly — can you prepare a 3-slide security appendix:
1) SOC2 scope and sample evidence
2) audit logs retention and access controls
3) KMS/HSM options and key lifecycle notes

Jonas — I’ll draft a single-slide "exec ask" (outcomes + decision next steps) and share it in the thread. I attached a first draft of an exec one-pager to use as pre-read.

I’ll avoid reply-all to the customer until we have a confirmed slot + attendee list; will let Jonas handle confirmation.

-Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-exec-onepager.pdf
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@clearlinehealth.com>, Brenda King <brenda.king@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo for CIO / exec team?

Jonas — thanks and that runbook looks good. We’ll take the first option: Wed, Nov 17, 15:00–15:45 PST.

Attendees from Clearline:
- Neel Varma — CIO
- Priya Shenoy — VP Engineering
- Aisha Patel — Infrastructure Manager

We prefer the executive overview format (short business + the key metrics), with a slightly longer time on latency and audit logs (Neel specifically asked for examples of observed tail latency under batch). Please include Kimberly for the compliance portion.

We’ll also schedule a 15-minute prep call on Nov 16, 10:30–10:45 PST to run through attendee expectations. Brenda (cc) will send the calendar invites for both events.

Please share the deck you plan to present and the one-slide executive ask ahead of the prep call.

Look forward to it.

—Sanjay

Attachments: Redwood-deck-v3.pdf (will accept final deck when you send)
